candidate_sentence_map.S1: During the 2025 financial year, TKM Grupp AS experienced a weakening of financial performance amid a challenging economic environment characterized by low consumer confidence, high price sensitivity, and domestic tax changes in Estonia, notably the introduction of a motor vehicle tax.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Consolidated sales revenue declined by 2.6 percent to 919.6 million euros compared to 944.6 million euros in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Profitability contracted more significantly, with profit before tax falling by 31.4 percent to 24.3 million euros and net profit decreasing by 36.1 percent to 17.5 million euros.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Net profit per share dropped to 43 cents from 67 cents.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Effective cost control helped mitigate pressures from rising expenses, while net profit also benefited from lower borrowing interest costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Performance varied across the Group's segments.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Supermarket revenue was broadly stable but profit declined, while the department stores segment recorded a loss.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Car trade weakened sharply, whereas real estate revenue and profit increased.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Investments fell to 25.5 million euros and were directed toward refurbishments, digital upgrades, and a new car centre.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Cash and cash equivalents also decreased during the year.

evaluation.label: Not generally
evaluation.justification: K1 is fully present with revenue and profit declines. K2 is missing entirely (no mention of car trade segment decline or Estonian motor vehicle tax). K3 is partially present (supermarket revenue stability and profit decline mentioned, but missing specific drivers and strategic investments). K4 is partially present (department stores loss mentioned, but missing revenue decline details and strategic actions). K5 is missing entirely (no real estate segment details). K6 is partially present (cash decrease mentioned, but missing working capital and liquidity risk context). K7 is missing entirely (no car segment expansion details). K8 is partially present (investments in refurbishments and digital upgrades mentioned, but missing specific projects like Jõgeva Selver refurbishment and CO₂ refrigeration systems). K9 is missing entirely (no dividend proposal details).
